description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Myr and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.
